title: Requirement for Stallholders to Personally Operate Their Hawker Stalls
what_it_is: Requirement for Stallholders to Personally Operate Their Hawker Stalls

sections.label: Hawkers must personally operate stalls
sections.summary: NEA requires hawkers to physically operate their stalls, which prevents subletting.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: By personal operations, the National Environment Agency (NEA) requires hawkers to physically operate their stalls.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The requirement for a hawker to personally operate the stall is important as it prevents subletting.

sections.label: Joint operators and rental waivers
sections.summary: Hawkers temporarily unable to operate for good reasons may appoint a joint operator or nominee, and NEA may extend rental waivers if the stall closes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Indeed, in situations where a hawker is temporarily unable to operate the stall for good reasons, for example, for medical reasons, he or she can appoint a joint operator or a nominee to operate the stall during that period.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: In the event that the stall has to close temporarily, NEA may also extend support through rental waivers.

sections.label: Stalls let below market rates
sections.summary: Stalls have been let out sometimes below market rent, with some successfully bidding as low as $1.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: As I have said, we have let out our stalls for sometimes even below market rates in terms of rent.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: And there are stalls that successfully bid as low as $1.

sections.label: Successful stallholders should relinquish stalls
sections.summary: Stallholders who expanded beyond hawker centres and lack time to run stalls should relinquish them, possibly nominating a family member.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: On Mr Chia's question about stallholders who have expanded their businesses to say, central kitchens and have many other food establishments elsewhere, I think if the persons have already expanded their business beyond hawker centres and are very successful, and they have no time to run the stalls themselves, I think it is only right that they actually relinquish the stalls to someone else who needs the space better and focus on their business instead.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: One option they could do this is to nominate their own family member to take over the stall.

sections.label: Encourage small businesses, not chains
sections.summary: The aim is to encourage more small businesses into the hawker trade without letting chain players dominate and change hawker culture.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Our aim is to encourage more small businesses to enter the hawker trade because of our low barrier to entry, but not allow chain players to start to dominate our hawker scene and change the texture and authenticity of our hawker culture.

sections.label: Nomination offer and Mubarak's stalls
sections.summary: NEA offered his wife the option to nominate another person to take over the stall during pregnancy, but they posted on social media instead.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Actually, NEA has offered his wife to nominate another person to take over the stall while she is undergoing pregnancy.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: But instead of accepting that as a legitimate option to do so, they decided to put it on social media to try and say that we have been unhelpful.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: I would say that for individuals like Mr Mubarak, who's running, I think about 20 stalls outside of the NEA system – he has two to three stalls in NEA hawker centres, but up to I think 21 registered stalls in other F&B establishments.

sections.label: Fairness in hawker centres
sections.summary: Hawker centres must maintain fairness, and individuals must be prevented from gaming the system by profiteering from subletting.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: So, we have to maintain fairness, because this is the important role that our hawker centres play.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: We are happy to see our hawkers succeed, but we must also prevent individuals from gaming the system by profiteering from subletting.

sections.label: Hawkers extending to chain model
sections.summary: Hawkers who wish to extend to a chain model can move out of hawker centres to other F&B establishments without restrictions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Because if hawkers wish to extend to a chain model and become bigger, they have the option to move out of the hawker centres and do it at other F&B establishments, where we do not impose the restrictions.
